title: Full FedAvg Training Loop
learning_objectives: Combine sampling, local training and aggregation over many rounds
entry_point: global_loss(w, clients); train_fedavg(clients, w0, rounds, fraction, lr, epochs, batch_size, seed)
hints: Global loss: total squared error over all clients / total samples.

failure_feedback.advice: Use seed*1000 + t*K + k for client k in round t and average only sampled clients.
Global loss = total squared error / total number of samples.
Every round must start local training from the current global w.
All randomness must come from seeded generators.
